semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, mana cost, type, entry Program, delayed owner return and static loyalty permission.
Mandatory target restrictions, captured Exile identity, source departure and owner return.
The required-target trigger cannot be put on the stack without another legal permanent.
A target that changes control or incarnation becomes illegal.
The ordinary single loyalty activation remains without Oath.
The same loyalty ability can be offered and activated twice, not a third time.
A different loyalty ability can be the second activation.
Synthetic suppression, restoration, control and current type changes affect the live permission.
Entering or leaving after the first use changes the live allowance.
Synthetic nonlegendary fixture sources establish that two permissions do not stack.
Synthetic control and face changes preserve history; a real zone change creates a new incarnation.
Oath leaves ordinary timing, costs and individual activation limits in force.
A paid loyalty activation remains counted after actual Tidebinder counters it.
A real Rings of Brighthearth copy is not a further activation.
Accepted phase, priority and cleanup commands reach a fresh turn and reset the allowance.
Accepted wire commands replay two loyalty activations deterministically.
A later Exile incarnation and a ceased token are not returned.
Actual Tidebinder can counter each independently staged trigger.
Synthetic source-control change preserves the captured trigger controller and its return observer.
A delayed trigger created during an end step waits until the next one.
Real commander owner choice determines whether the exact Exile incarnation remains for the observer.
The returning Aura's owner chooses an untargeted legal attachment through hexproof.
An Aura without a legal recipient remains exiled.
A begun foreign-owned Aura return survives the trigger controller's departure and replays once.
A departed Aura owner removes the entrant and retires the parked return once.
The surviving owner selects a valid Clone copy source after the trigger controller leaves.
The departed Clone owner's parked return completes without leaving a prompt.
The owner orders actual entry-counter replacements after the trigger controller leaves.
A departed returning owner retires the saved counter-entry transaction.
A departed copy candidate is removed while the surviving exact choice remains available.
One synthetically foreign-owned replacement source departs; the remaining actual replacement applies once.
A synthetic later incarnation is not overwritten by the old parked entry.
Waiting and stacked but unbegun delayed work is removed when its controller leaves.
A synthetically changed unrelated leaf does not qualify for exact-return preservation.
An actual Banishing Light Aura observer suspends Koya's typed return; a synthetic observable tail runs once after the entrant owner leaves.
The suspended typed counter-entry transaction keeps its progress when one replacement source departs; its synthetic observable tail runs once.
